premises: Plasma nitriding Ti-6Al-4V in NH3-N2 (1:2) at 750 °C for 4 h forms a ~2 μm Ti-N compound layer
This layer eliminates stick-tear/plowing wear and reduces friction coefficient vs. untreated alloy
Nitride layers introduce compressive residual stresses that inhibit crack nucleation
Low-temperature nitriding (e.g., 600 °C) can improve fatigue properties by limiting premature crack initiation
